## Overview

A customer targeting case study based on **Intuit QuickBooks** marketing data. The goal was to decide which customers to contact in a follow-up campaign so the outreach budget goes to the people most likely to respond.

## Problem

Mailing every customer is expensive and most won't respond. The business needed a way to rank customers by response likelihood and a clear rule for where to stop targeting.

## Approach

- Built customer targeting models with **logistic regression** and **random forest**
- Segmented customers by predicted response likelihood to prioritize the highest-value outreach
- Applied **breakeven and ROI analysis** to set the targeting threshold, contacting only customers whose expected profit beats the cost of reaching them
- Used LLM-assisted development to speed up exploration and iteration

## Results

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Projected conversion lift | **18%** |
| Projected profit | **$410K** |

## Tech Stack

`Python` · `Pandas` · `Scikit-learn` · `Logistic Regression` · `Random Forest` · `Breakeven & ROI Analysis`
